description: Unit tests for the SpdySimpleArena class, testing memory allocation, duplication, reset, free, and reallocation functionalities.

methods.name: NoAllocationOnConstruction
methods.description: Tests that no memory is allocated upon construction of SpdySimpleArena.

methods.name: Memdup
methods.description: Tests duplicating a string into the arena and verifying correctness.

methods.name: MemdupLargeString
methods.description: Tests duplicating a large string with a small block size.

methods.name: MultipleBlocks
methods.description: Tests multiple string duplications across different memory blocks.

methods.name: UseAfterReset
methods.description: Tests arena behavior after reset and string duplication.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Tests freeing memory and reusing freed memory within the arena.

methods.name: Alloc
methods.description: Tests allocating memory blocks of various sizes.

methods.name: Realloc
methods.description: Tests reallocating memory within the arena, including shrinking and expanding.
